about.p1: In this space you'll find all my programming, cybersecurity and networking projects, which I'll be updating and improving over time.
about.p2: The idea is to share part of my learning, tools and solutions, and also offer resources for those who want to explore and learn a bit more about these topics.
about.p3: I combine my focus on cybersecurity and networking with a touch of futuristic and retro creativity, exploring systems and networks to find ways to make them more secure. When I'm not working, studying, or experimenting with new configurations, I let myself be inspired by the music and games of my childhood. If you like, hit play and join me on this experience.

about.foco2Texto: TCP/IP, TLS, OpenWrt and traffic analysis with Wireshark and tcpdump.
about.foco3Texto: Spring Boot with JWT, role-based access control and credential hashing.
